import numpy as np,mujoco
from rcb_hb import Session
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data
  self.ikd=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.p=np.array([-.17399191,.68388161,-.46305106,9.76185477,4.08231538,-.04204698,-.01316913])
  self.lastq=np.zeros(19)
 def pose(self,knee=.684,cy=0,cx=.025,torso=0,arms=None):
  d=self.d;p=self.p;c=d.subtree_com[1];f=d.site_xpos[1:3].mean(0);R=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3)
  pitch=np.arctan2(R[0,2],R[2,2]);roll=np.arctan2(-R[1,2],R[2,2])
  q=np.zeros(19);q[[2,7]]=p[0]-.5*(knee-p[1]);q[[3,8]]=knee;q[[4,9]]=p[2]-.5*(knee-p[1])
  q[[4,9]]+=p[3]*(c[0]-f[0]-cx)+p[4]*d.qvel[0]
  q[[2,7]]+=p[5]*pitch+p[6]*d.qvel[4]
  q[[1,6]]= -2*(c[1]-f[1]-cy)-.65*d.qvel[1] + .5*roll + .1*d.qvel[3]
  q[10]=torso
  if arms is not None:q[11:]=arms
  self.lastq=q.copy()
  return np.clip(2*(q-self.s.low.action_low)/(self.s.low.action_high-self.s.low.action_low)-1,-1,1)
 def ik(self,targets,torso=0,iterations=12):
  z=self.ikd;z.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;z.qpos[17]=torso
  # Dampened least squares independently, starting from actual pose.
  for side,target in enumerate(targets):
   if target is None:continue
   idx=np.arange(18+4*side,22+4*side);v=np.arange(17+4*side,21+4*side)
   for _ in range(iterations):
    mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,z);err=np.array(target)-z.site_xpos[7+side]
    jac=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,z,jac,None,7+side);J=jac[:,v]
    dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.003*np.eye(3),err)
    z.qpos[idx]=np.clip(z.qpos[idx]+np.clip(dq,-.25,.25),self.s.low.action_low[11+4*side:15+4*side],self.s.low.action_high[11+4*side:15+4*side])
  return z.qpos[18:26].copy()
